rationale: The payload register is intentionally not reset, but it is written only with a valid item and the reset valid bit prevents consumers from observing stale payload state.

mutation.description: Kept the source FIFO's valid-controlled payload storage while reducing the handshake to one slot.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the FIFO to a single registered stream item and retained unreset data storage guarded by valid.
